items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: She speaks on that matter of who will claim him based on how he’s doing.

Yeah, well that’s a good observation because if he does well they say “Oh yeah, he is mixed.” But if he does poorly, “He was a black! I told you we should have never elected that guy!” (Laughs). When he was made the president it was a lot of young white people voting for him also who were looking for something better than they had. He was such an intelligent, great man to me. Like I told you earlier, Bill Clinton was a great man to me too, and so was Obama. I’m looking forward to something good happening if it’s…

I want to touch, a little bit more, on the Heath Brothers. Since Percy’s passing in 2005, that obviously changes the dynamic of your group immensely. Can you talk a little bit about Jeb, who plays piano, and the bassist who is trying to fill those very large shoes on stage?
